text:
Ava (marketing lead): quick sync — we need to distill copy for the tri-mode pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and lock the webinar CTA + launch posts. timeline: draft by Tue, runway to staging Wed.
Ravi (growth): +1. main goal: tie benchmark narrative to the webinar so the launch posts drive both signups and qualified inbound. can we get 1 hero + 1 subhead per mode? keep it skimmable. :memo:
Maya (product): must include the tradeoffs concisely. suggestions: Hosted = fastest time-to-value, Dedicated = predictable throughput & SLAs, Private = VPC & compliance. one sentence each.
Jon (content): ok i’ll draft 3 variants. rough first pass here — choose tone 'confident & engineer-friendly'.
Jon (content): Hosted hero v1: "Start generating — Hosted API for instant access, curated open models, pay-as-you-go." subhead: "Integrate in minutes. Scale without infra headaches."
Jon (content): Dedicated hero v1: "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and enterprise SLAs." subhead: "Pin capacity, hit SLOs, and keep costs steady."
Jon (content): Private hero v1: "Private deployment that fits your security posture." subhead: "VPC and on-prem options with KMS/HSM integrations."
Lena (demand gen): these are good. for the webinar module we need a compact promo: title, 1-line why it matters, CTA. Proposed: "Benchmarks & tradeoffs: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private" line: "Real workloads, latency & cost breakouts, and migration case studies." CTA: "Reserve your seat" (links to form).
Ravi (growth): routing rules for inbound from webinar page: FormBot will map leads -> HubSpot. logic: if "company_size" >= 200 OR "region" == EMEA + "enterprise" checkbox => route to AE queue. otherwise SDR. Also tag form submissions with campaign = "tri_mode_bench" and utm params.
FormBot: confirmed. mapping snippet: `POST /hooks/hubspot
payload: {"email": "{{email}}", "campaign": "tri_mode_bench", "lead_tier": "{{tier}}"}`
Jon (content): can we include a microcopy line next to the CTA that reduces friction? e.g., "Free bench report for attendees" or "Watch live + get the benchmark PDF". low friction wins.
Maya (product): add a short bullet on page under each hero with 2 measurable claims we can back: latency p50/p95 for hosted example, typical throughput for Dedicated (tokens/sec), compliance certs for Private. ops/infra will upload the numbers.
Ava (marketing lead): editorial constraints: hero max 10 words, subhead max 14. CTA copy variants: "Get benchmark", "Reserve spot", "Try Hosted now" (for hosted panel). Put webinar CTA above the fold on the tri-mode landing.
Lena (demand gen): newsletter/launch post cadence: 3 short posts (announcement, benchmark teaser, webinar reminder). sample post copy: "We’re publishing a live benchmark across Hosted / Dedicated / Private — join our webinar to see real tradeoffs and migration tips." link -> form.
Ravi (growth): tracking: use `?utm_source=launch_post&utm_campaign=tri_mode_bench&utm_medium=social` on shared links. ensure canonical page sets `og:title` based on the hero variant selected for A/B.
Jon (content): quick A/B hero variants saved to /marketing/copy/tri-mode/v1. i’ll push to staging with CMS snippets: `hero_variant=A` or `B` in query so we can QA.
Ava (marketing lead): action items: Jon — push 3 hero variants + subheads by Tue noon. Maya — confirm measurable claims and send numbers by Tue 5pm. Lena — draft 3 launch posts and webinar mail content by Tue EOD. Ravi — hook up HubSpot routing & utm by Wed morning. FormBot — confirm payload mappings.
Lena (demand gen): noted. I'll also add targeting for APAC times for the webinar and a secondary link for on-demand.
Maya (product): small ask: can the webinar registration form include a single-choice: "Primary use case" (chat, embeddings, reranking, other). that'll help post-webinar segmentation.
Ravi (growth): yep — map that to the lead property `primary_use_case`. we'll use it for follow-up nurture flows.
Ava (marketing lead): last note — for the launch posts, avoid heavy marketing jargon. keep it technical and outcome-oriented. we want engineers & platform leads to read it. :rocket:
Jon (content): will do. i'll drop drafts in the #marketing-drafts thread and ping here when live.
FormBot: routing and sample payload tested in staging. all good.
Ava (marketing lead): thanks team — next check Fri morning for QA & final sign-off. :sparkles:
